name: Bossa root-five
desc: Classic bossa nova bass in Ab major: round sine root-five movement through a I-vi-ii-V turnaround, anticipating each new bar by half a beat the Brazilian way; peak adds gentle approach notes and a soft octave answer.

root.doc: semitone offset from Ab major home

code.full: note("<[ab1@2 eb2 [~ ab1]] [f1@2 c2 [~ f1]] [bb1@2 f2 [~ bb1]] [eb2@2 bb1 [~ eb1]]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.015).decay(.28).sustain(.5).release(.2).shape(.3).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.2).slow(32)).clip(.92).gain(${gain}).room(.25).every(8, x=>x.ply("1 1 1 2")).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[ab1@2 eb2 [g1 ab1]] [f1@2 c2 [~ f1]] [bb1@2 f2 [a1 bb1]] [eb2 bb1 eb2 [db2 c2]]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.012).decay(.25).sustain(.48).release(.18).shape(.35).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).clip(.9).gain(${gain}), note("<[~ ~ ~ ab2] [~ ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ bb2] [~ ~ ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").decay(.2).sustain(.1).shape(.25).lpf(${cut}*1.6).gain(${gain}*.4)).room(.22).orbit(3).play()
